feature_contract.goal: Complete F11 menu font-density and control layout resilience to XR resize/recenter while preserving readable glyph raster, gameplay/menu focus, inputs, persistent font settings and desktop fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R23 common binocular XR extent reader and ImGui F11 density consumer only; does not modify gameplay HUD, ESC, world, SkyGlow, FFB, DX11 or DXVK.
trace_stages: XR host publishes recommended widths and heights for both eyes inside a shared pose seqlock.
R23 common R26/R29 game bridge reads one complete even-sequence four-field XR publication.
F11 EndScene chooses ImGui font glyph density, uploads D3D9 atlas and displays through external UI eye projection.
subcomponents: Introduce coherent pair-size R23 API, valid in R26 safe-comparison and full R29 backends, with odd-sequence retry and bounds checks.
Consume pair atomically for F11 atlas density without losing existing 10 percent geometry guard, reset retention or desktop font size; extend active mutation gates.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: No mixed-generation F11 atlas rebuild at resize/recenter; use only coherent binocular XR extents.
Bad/odd host publication retains current VR atlas while original desktop close, shell hitboxes and focus remain unchanged.
Same result SHA must pass DX9Ex Active host/game/package and Domain Isolation and source-impact gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: F11 independently queried R23 left/right eye extents; a 10% geometric tolerance can still accept values from different host publication generations.
source_trace: XR host publishes four eye extents between sequence even/odd generation boundaries.
F11 EndScene reads separate left/right values with a heuristic that cannot prove one publication.
A plausible mixed pair changes ImGui font density bucket and forces GPU atlas texture rebuild even without a true coherent resize.
diagnosis.root_cause: No generation-fenced binocular extent read existed in R23 overlay-facing API, despite HUD R29 owning a separate seqlock-safe path.
alternatives_rejected: R29 owner API cannot be linked by the R26 safe-draw F11 comparison target.
Disabling XR-responsive atlas regeneration would regress Quest3 font legibility.
Removing the existing 10% per-eye geometry tolerance would admit malformed eye extents.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R23 provides a bounded even/unmodified-sequence pair read; F11 consumes it once per EndScene before unchanged font bucket and shell sizing logic.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing F11 destructive verifier updated for coherent pair and pinned sequence, all four axis reads, 640/480..8192 bounds and output mapping.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Both eyes now share one stable host publication epoch for F11 density; stereo transforms remain independent and unchanged.

runtime_note: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED; not tested on Quest3/VDXR. Optical readability, focus and frame-time acceptance pending.
